description: Classic first-depositor share inflation attack on ERC4626 vault without virtual share offset

expected_finding.root_cause: VulnerableVault.convertToShares uses spot balance without virtual offset, enabling first-depositor inflation
expected_finding.invariant_violated: shares * pricePerShare == deposited_assets for all depositors
expected_finding.attack_summary: Attacker deposits 1 wei (gets 1 share), donates large amount to vault, victim deposits and receives 0 shares
